items.quote: Empty inputs are refused instead of being run or enqueued. Query text that is '' or whitespace-only returns EmptyQueryObjectError before any node runs: no LLM or embedding call, and no trace is persisted.

Selector(capability=[]) is refused with a named refusal on every route that accepts a selector (/query, /compare, /documents, /documents/upload, DELETE /documents, and the MCP tools). It never resolves to the bypass wiring, never renders an empty compare key, and no node runs.
POST /compare detects every comparison-key collision before any arm executes, and each arm executes exactly the wiring that the pre-check resolved.
POST /promote refuses, with a named refusal, an alias that is empty or that no Selector could carry (one that matches the hash shape ^(sha256:)?[0-9a-f]{64}$), and writes no ledger row.
On POST /documents/upload, a selector form field that holds the JSON literal 'null' or an empty string means 'no selector' (the default wiring).
Every concrete SeamRefusalError subclass that a transport can return is exported from one refusal catalogue (refusals.__all__ or a documented re-export list).
An ingest's file_name is either carried through to the v1 document record, so citations name the uploaded file instead of '<document_id>.bin' or 'unknown_source'

Seam docstrings and dead code match the behaviour. The rest.py promote docstrings say that a non-string verb is a validation error and that only a non-member string gives UnrecognisedPromotionVerbError.
